seed_group_note: inclusive ranges; 16 seeds per group; pilot seeds 701..704 and control seeds 801..928 excluded
step_cap_note: raised from 2^28 after pilot G-budget failure (max t_final 7.6e7 > 2^28/4)
primary_kappa: ln kappa_time = ln(f_B) - ln(PA_time), f_B = b_dep/steps, PA_time = sum_pa/steps; kappa_end reported as sensitivity
primary_tail_estimand: ln of pooled nearest-rank q99.9 of complete-contained I episode durations, pooled over the 16 seeds of one group, per rule x band
outcome_per_group: mean over the group's 16 seeds of per-seed ln kappa_time

P1.statistic: mean over rotations of Spearman(ln q999 [first group], mean ln kappa_time [second group]) over 44 rules
P1.success: statistic <= -0.30 and rule-bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0 at BOTH bands (intersection-union, no multiplicity adjustment)

P2.statistic: R2_cv(baseline + tail) - R2_cv(baseline), R2_cv = 1 - sum (y - yhat_loo)^2 / sum (y - ybar_loo)^2
P2.success: mean gain >= 0.10 and bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0 at BOTH bands

reliability_gate: G-reliab: Spearman between groups (A vs B for ln q999; C vs D for mean ln kappa_time) >= 0.5 per band; if either fails P1/P2 are reported as not testable at this precision, results still shown

gates.G-quantile: >= 10000 pooled complete-contained I episodes per rule x band x group

bootstrap.resample: rules (with all their groups and both bands together)

inclusion: all 44 rules, all 64 seeds; no rule or run is dropped; failed gates reported
